events.name: Bash
events.head: Check current hub state, regenerate, and read task statuses
events.input: $ git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py workshop-plan/index.html; git status --short | head -20; grep -n "d-prove" workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py | head; grep -c "Launch Control" workshop-plan/index.html workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py; grep -n 'id="tasks"' workshop-plan/index.html | head; python3 workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short | head; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the live mirror hub and whether hub changes are pushed
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; curl -sL "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/index.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/hub_live.html; wc -c /tmp/hub_live.html; grep -c "Launch Control" /tmp/hub_live.html; grep -c "onboarding/d1-prove" /tmp/hub_live.html; grep -o '"d-prove"[^}]\{0,200\}' /tmp/hub_live.html | head -2; grep -n -o '.\{80\}tasks\.html.\{60\}' /tmp/hub_live.html | grep -i 'hash\|location' | head -3; grep -c 'id="tasks"' /tmp/hub_live.html; cmp <(sed 's/[0-9]\{4\}-[0-9-]*T[0-9:+]*//g' workshop-plan/index.html) <(sed 's/[0-9]\{4\}-[0-9-]*T[0-9:+]*//g' /tmp/hub_live.html
